summary: Build audit-ready grant records, metadata, workflows, and finance-MEAL controls. Develop practical governance tools with TrainingCred.
lede: Grant records management training helps grant, finance, records, and MEAL professionals organize traceable evidence across the grant lifecycle. Participants learn to build classification and metadata systems, map approval and reporting workflows, reconcile financial and monitoring evidence, and set retention and access controls through practical exercises that support audit-ready records and informed grant oversight.
audienceIntro: Grant records management training suits cross-functional professionals who must connect programme delivery, financial control, monitoring evidence, and information stewardship.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to grant administration, project finance, records management, programme delivery, MEAL, audit, or related information workflows. You do not need programming experience. Familiarity with spreadsheets and your organization’s grant filing or reporting process will help you apply the exercises. Advanced topics such as system integration, AI-assisted classification, and information-security architecture receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical engineering instruction.
